maria: Quick sync — postmortem follow-up for the billing/usage incident on 2026-03-19 (delayed ingestion + duplicate token counts). I pasted the remediation slate below. Please claim owners and give an ETA by EOD so we can update customers and billing ops. Link to doc: https://redwood.internal/pm/billing-postmortem-0319 :eyes:

Remediation slate (high level):
1) Fix ingest pipeline dedupe (root cause = retry dedupe gap) — owner: unclaimed — ETA: ?
2) Backfill missing/delayed usage for 03/19-03/21 (customer-facing corrections) — owner: unclaimed — ETA: ?
3) Invoice credits & manual corrections for impacted customers — owner: unclaimed — ETA: ?
4) Alerting & metric (delta between token ingest vs upstream events) — owner: unclaimed — ETA: ?
5) Postmortem doc updates + recurring incident pattern analysis — owner: unclaimed — ETA: ?

Notes: there are ~420 customers affected, expected credit volume ~low-mid 5 figures. Need eng + finance + support coordination.

ajay: I can take #1 (ingest dedupe). Will triage today and have a rollback-safe patch by tomorrow morning, ETA 2026-03-25 10:00 PT. I also want to add an integration test so retries don't double-count.

kyla: I'll take #3 (invoice credits & manual corrections). Plan: create list of impacted subscriptions, propose credit amounts, run small pilot with 10 customers for sign-off, then bulk apply. Target: pilot by 2026-03-26, bulk by 2026-03-30. I’ll coordinate with support for messaging.

sam: I can handle #2 (backfill). Need queries + safe idempotent backfill job. Running an initial counts diff now and will post SQL.

sam: SQL snippet for the reconciliation (preview) — please review before I run:```sql
-- identify duplicate token events grouped by request_id and timestamp
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT request_id, event_ts, token_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY request_id ORDER BY event_ts) as rn
  FROM ingestion.events
  WHERE event_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-19' AND '2026-03-21'
)
SELECT request_id, SUM(token_count) as total_tokens, COUNT(*) as occurrences
FROM ordered
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY request_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
```
This will let us build an idempotent backfill that applies the delta only. I’ll run a dry-run on staging and post results by 3pm PT.

billing-bot: Daily ingestion-job report: 2026-03-24 06:00 UTC — job-runtime=2m34s, processed=1,236,014 events, dup-detection=off (flag=0) :warning:

maria: @ajay thanks — please include the retry-test case in CI and tag @leo for infra review. @sam make sure the backfill writes a tombstone or audit row so finance can reconcile easily. @kyla nice plan — can you draft the pilot message for support?

ajay: will do. tagging @leo for infra review — @leo can you give a quick ✅ or list infra blockers?

leo: I’ll review the patch and infra change early tomorrow. No blockers expected, but want to sanity-check the mem usage for the dedupe window. If we need to widen the window we might need a config knob. ETA review: 2026-03-25 09:30 PT.

kyla: Draft pilot message for support (copy suggestion):
"Hi — we’re contacting customers who saw inflated usage on 2026-03-19 due to a transient ingestion issue. We’re applying a small credit and will follow up with the invoice correction. No action required on your part. Reach support if you have questions."

maria: looks good. Add a note about expected credit amount range and a link to the FAQ doc. Also please include owner for outbound email.

sam: dry-run results: staging diff shows 2,364 duplicate token events across 78 requests, delta tokens = 41,892. I’ll schedule the production backfill for 2026-03-25 01:30 UTC (low traffic window).

ajay: thanks. I’ll ship the dedupe patch 2026-03-25 06:00 UTC and enable dup-detection flag in canary. If metrics look stable for 2 hours we promote.

maria: Recurring pattern note — this looks similar to the Dec 2025 incident but smaller scope. @ajay can you include a short section in the postmortem about why this recurred and what permanent guardrails we need? Also add an alert that triggers when ingestion lag > 5m AND delta(token_ingest, upstream_events) > 0.5%.

ajay: will add the recurring-pattern section. For alerting we should add both a rate-based and absolute delta alert; I’ll draft thresholds and post to this thread by EOD.

kyla: I created finance ticket FIN-4821 for manual credits + FIN-4822 for invoice adjustments. Will link to customer list when ready.

maria: thanks all. Action items recap (leave as checklist):
- [x] assign owners (ajay/#1, sam/#2, kyla/#3, leo/review)
- [ ] dedupe patch shipped + test in CI (ajay) — ETA 2026-03-25 06:00 UTC
- [ ] backfill run (sam) — ETA 2026-03-25 01:30 UTC
- [ ] pilot credits (kyla) — ETA 2026-03-26
- [ ] alerts + postmortem updates (ajay + maria) — ETA 2026-03-27
- [ ] customer comms + invoice adjustments (kyla + finance) — ETA 2026-03-30

If anyone needs to reassign, ping here. I’ll update the postmortem doc and slack thread after each milestone. :thumbsup:
